title: Conveyancing Assistant
description:
Conveyancing Assistant Location Stockton-on-Tees Salary

£26,000 - £28,000 per annum

Job Description

The Conveyancing Assistant supports solicitors and licenced conveyancers in the delivery of residential property transactions. The role involves managing administrative tasks, liaising with clients and third parties, and assisting in the preparation and progression of conveyancing files from instruction to completion. This position requires strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and effective communication to ensure a smooth conveyancing process.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
- Assist in the preparation and submission of legal documents related to property sales, purchases, remortgages, and transfers.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date client files and records in accordance with regulatory and firm standards.
- Liaise with clients, estate agents, mortgage lenders, local authorities, and other relevant parties to obtain necessary information and documentation.
- Conduct initial client contact and provide updates on case progress.
- Arrange and manage appointments, including client meetings and property searches.
- Process and monitor searches and enquiries, ensuring timely responses and follow-ups.
- Assist with the drafting of contracts, completion statements, and other conveyancing paperwork under supervision.
- Track and manage financial transactions related to client accounts, including deposits and completion funds.
- Support the conveyancing team in meeting deadlines and managing workloads effectively.
- Ensure compliance with firm policies, professional standards, and relevant legislation.

This wole will provide support to the lead Conveyancer, ideally a minimum of 1 years experience in a Conveyancing environment would be prefrerred to apply today please send a CV to:- (url removed)

title: Conveyancing Assistant
description:
Job Description

The role of Conveyancing Assistant involves providing comprehensive administrative support to solicitors and conveyancers within a busy legal practise. The post holder assists with the progression of residential property transactions by managing documentation, liaising with clients and other parties, and ensuring compliance with legal protocols. This position requires strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work efficiently under supervision to meet deadlines.

Key Responsibilities
- Assist in the preparation and management of conveyancing documentation including contracts, deeds, and other legal forms.
- Liaise with clients, estate agents, mortgage lenders, surveyors, and local authorities to obtain necessary information and updates.
- Open and maintain client files, ensuring all records are accurate and up to date in accordance with firm procedures and regulatory requirements.
- Monitor the progress of property transactions and keep clients informed of developments in a timely and professional manner.
- Arrange and coordinate appointments, including property searches and exchanges of contracts, as directed by the conveyancer.
- Manage administrative tasks such as data entry, photocopying, scanning, and filing to support the conveyancing team.
- Ensure compliance with anti-money laundering regulations by assisting with due diligence checks and client identification processes.
- Support the conveyancers by preparing reports and correspondence as required.
- Maintain confidentiality and adhere to data protection legislation in all aspects of work.

The successful candidate will ideally have previous experience of LEAP and ideally one years experience working within a Conveyancing environment.

The ideal candidate will be someone who who can work as part of a team and also on their own.

Please apply today to:- (url removed)

title: Remortgage Paralegal
description:
Remortgage Paralegal

Location: Sunderland or Teesside

Salary: £26,000 - £28,000 per annum

Job Description

The role of Remortgage Paralegal involves providing comprehensive legal support within the remortgage team, managing caseloads efficiently to ensure the timely progression of remortgage transactions. The successful candidate will deal with all aspects of remortgage conveyancing, liaising with clients, lenders, and other relevant parties to facilitate smooth completion of cases.

Job Duties
- Manage a caseload of remortgage files from receipt of instruction through to completion, ensuring all deadlines and compliance requirements are met.
- Conduct thorough legal searches and investigations, including title, local authority, and environmental searches.
- Draught and review legal documents such as contracts, transfer deeds, and mortgage deeds, ensuring accuracy and adherence to regulatory guidelines.
- Prepare completion statements and handle financial calculations related to remortgage transactions.
- Maintain regular communication with clients, lenders, estate agents, and other stakeholders to provide updates and resolve queries promptly.
- Ensure compliance with Money Laundering Regulations and other relevant legislation by carrying out client due diligence checks.
- Work closely with solicitors and senior colleagues to resolve complex legal issues and escalate matters when necessary.
- Utilise case management software to record and update case progress, ensuring all documentation is correctly filed and stored.
- Keep up to date with changes in legal practise, legislation, and industry standards related to remortgage conveyancing.
